task_name: Domino Delights BR Creative Validation Test Validity Review (INVALID - re-run after eligibility fix)
authoring_notes: Two items only, both surviving the three-condition test: the behaviour is observable in the trajectory, no outcome artifact proves it, and the prompt requires it. Two earlier candidates were dropped. A channel-discovery item was removed because the connector exposes no acting-user parameter on Slack reads, so the 'blocked plain listing' it graded may never occur, and reaching the thread is already implied by every findings rubric. A workbook tab-listing item was removed because a single spreadsheet read returns tab structure and cell contents together, making the list-before-select ordering unobservable, and because an objective compliance item already requires both tab names.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent reviews the partner exchange from the start of the January event-defect sequence before it forms the measurement integrity conclusion, rather than relying on the most recent messages.
rubrics.justification: The event-defect sequence only reads correctly from its start, and the newest messages sit after the review date and look like a resolution. An artifact can show a correct measurement conclusion without showing whether the Agent surveyed the sequence or landed on its tail and reasoned backwards, which is the difference between a finding and a lucky guess.
rubrics.evidence: Trajectory shows the Agent working through partner-channel messages from the earlier January period, not only 2026-01-27 and later, ahead of the point where it settles the measurement integrity question.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent searches the studio's own ticket tracker for existing work on test validity, store availability or device eligibility before it creates any new ticket.
rubrics.justification: The prompt requires the sweep so duplicates are avoided, which only helps if it runs first. Final state shows that tickets exist and that a sweep was reported, but not that the check preceded the creation.
rubrics.evidence: Trajectory shows a ticket search on those themes occurring before the first ticket creation call.
